pluginText.pf.visit: {"checkIn":"at the center: the parent gives the check-in code at the desk and signs the child in; pick-up only by an adult on the approved list, with photo ID; at home: the code at the door and a parent or caregiver stays home; at school: the school's own sign-in, then the code","changes":"the analyst updates the treatment plan and the hours: a change in hours is a new schedule the parent OKs, and the plan's approval may be needed first; nothing is sold at a session","cantGoAhead":"the child is sick (fever or vomiting, the practice's sick rule), no adult is home for a home session, the plan's approval has ended, or the technician can't come and nobody on the child's team can: the session is cancelled with no fee","done":"the code at drop-off, then DONE from the technician once the session note is done in the practice's own records; session data and progress reports stay in the practice's records; the parent gets a short daily note on the secure page; Rosie keeps only booking records","incidents":"an injury, a restraint, or a child running off during a session: the parent is called at once and gets a written incident report the same day"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"before":"most families take nothing when booking (the plan pays); self-pay families save a card, charged once a week for that week's sessions","insurance":"health plans: only the plan's name before times; member details on the secure page; the practice asks for the plan's approval for the hours and bills the plan; copays or the family's share are billed once a month in one bill; public program families pay nothing","approval":"the plan approves a number of hours a week until an end date (about 6 months); sessions are booked only inside the approved hours and dates; the practice asks for a renewal, with a reassessment, before it ends","caps":"deposit cap: from the state form","fees":"no missed-session fee by default; a late-cancel fee only if the owner sets one at sign-up and confirms it for each case; never billed to a plan or a public program","payOverTime":"the practice's own payment plan, only if the owner turns it on","tips":"none","tax":"no tax on health care","rosfield":"the $2 per booking applies to every kind of work, health included: a flat fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes, shown at sign-up for the owner's yes; card payments cost only Stripe's own card fee"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never":"the child's diagnosis, behaviors, health, session data, progress and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the practice's name, the day, the time and the place, and name the child only by first initial","staffTexts":"technicians and the owner get the child's initials, the time and the place; behavior and health notes stay on the secure page","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"every text goes to the parent or guardian; separated parents each get texts only as the custody papers allow","school":"Rosie never texts the school; the parent forwards the school its OK link","displayName":"a switch: the practice texts under a plain display name, Lee Family Care or Lee Home Care; card statements show it too"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"analysts certified (and licensed where the state requires); technicians registered and supervised","skills":"behavior analyst, behavior technician, trained on a given child's plan (per child), parent training, social skills groups, home sessions, school sessions, toddlers, Spanish, sign language","supervision":"each technician has a named supervising analyst who supervises at the share the board and the plan require (the analyst joins sessions)","oks":"the analyst OKs plan changes, a new technician on a child's team, and a return after an incident; the owner OKs schedule changes and fees","standIn":"only a technician already trained on this child's plan (on the child's team), and the parent is told before the session; nobody new is sent to a child without the parent's yes; nobody on the team free: the session is cancelled with no fee","ratio":"one technician per child in therapy sessions; one staff for every 3 children in groups","away":"home and school sessions only by staff cleared for them"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"privacy":"a health privacy agreement (a business associate agreement) is signed before going live; children's details only on the secure page","records":"a child's records are kept as long as the state's rules require (often until some years after the child turns 18); never deleted on request while the rules say keep them; Rosie keeps only booking records","consent":"a parent's or guardian's written consent for treatment, for any restraint in the plan, and for photos or video; separate releases for the school or other providers","restraint":"only as the child's written plan and the state's rules allow; every use written down and the parent told the same day","reporting":"staff are required to report suspected child abuse or neglect to the state's hotline","school":"sessions at school only with the school's written OK and the parent's consent","showFacts":"the analyst's certification and license shown where the state's rules require it","reviews":"a rating may be asked of a parent at most once a quarter, never after an incident; any reply never confirms the family is a client"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"approvalEnds":"the plan's approval is about to end: the reassessment is booked before; not renewed: sessions stop or turn self-pay only with the parent's yes","techSick":"a technician can't come: only a technician on the child's team, with the parent told before; nobody: cancelled with no fee","childSick":"the child is sick: cancelled with no fee under the practice's sick rule","latePickup":"a parent is late to pick up: the child stays with staff; the parent, then the emergency contact, is called","notDroppedOff":"a child not dropped off for a center session: the parent is called, no fee words","runsOff":"a child runs off: 911 and the parent at once","incident":"an injury or restraint: the parent is called at once and gets a written report the same day","custody":"separated parents: the papers decide who books, consents, gets texts and picks up","school":"school sessions: the school's written OK first","manySessions":"many sessions a week: one repeat plan; reminders and ratings must not flood the family","other":"all other edge cases the generic way"}
